title: subagent: Check Wikipedia penguin population exact number

content:
I need to verify the exact total penguin population figure stated on English Wikipedia around end of 2012. 

Please try:
1. Visit https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Penguin&oldid=515794054 (a 2012-era revision) or try to find an archived version
2. Also try https://web.archive.org/web/2012*/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penguin
3. Search for "penguin population 19 million" or "penguin population 20 million" to find the exact figure
4. Check if the Wikipedia article on penguins said something like "The total number of penguins is estimated at 18-19 million" or similar

I'm looking for the EXACT number stated as the "upper estimate" of total penguin population at the end of 2012 on English Wikipedia. Was it 18 million, 19 million, 20 million, or some other number?

Please report the exact figure and the exact wording used.
